goal: Implement Orbit AI relationship recommendations for goal-based contact discovery with measurable relevance.

success_criteria.description: A relationship recommendation service accepts a user goal and ranks contacts using profile, relationship, event, conversation, and follow-up signals with source-backed reasons.
GET /app/agent goal-based contact prompts display recommended contacts with why-this-person, confidence, evidence snippets, and links to contact detail pages.

Ten named evaluation cases cover industry fit, market-entry help, investor search, organizer intro, weak-tie relevance, negative match filtering, ambiguous goals, Chinese input, English input, and privacy-limited data.
Focused tests assert ranking quality for the ten cases, including at least one rejected high-profile but irrelevant contact in each negative-match scenario.
The feature documentation records the design-evaluation-analysis loop and the minimum score threshold required before the UI presents recommendations as ready.

out_of_scope: Adding vector indexes, embeddings, live CRM sync, or external network writes
Hardcoding final recommendation text per evaluation prompt
Changing contact detail page layout except links consumed by this feature
